title: Harness event whitelist omits Ev_Stock_Arrived — inventory demos can't assert stock arrival
evidence:
harness/demo_parse.odin valid_event_name:
	case "packet_arrived", "packet_dropped", "forecast_issued", "warning_raised",
		 "crisis_triggered", "crisis_resolved", "grace_started", "grace_expired",
		 "run_won", "run_lost", "node_spawned", "meter_changed", "warning_cleared":
		return true
core/events.odin:
	Ev_Stock_Arrived,
	Ev_Stock_Arrived :: struct { links: i32, routers: i32 }
core/run.odin:
	emit(state, tick, Ev_Stock_Arrived{links = nl, routers = nr})
(event_matches at demo_parse.odin:317 likewise has no "stock_arrived" arm)
detail: Inventory emits Ev_Stock_Arrived (run.odin:165, serialized as event tag 14), but the demo parser's strict event whitelist omits "stock_arrived" — `expect event stock_arrived` is a hard parse error, so the new feature's arrival event is unassertable in any demo.
recommended_fix: Add "stock_arrived" to the valid_event_name case list and a matching `case "stock_arrived": _, ok := e.kind.(pp.Ev_Stock_Arrived); return ok` arm in event_matches (demo_parse.odin).
